# NO SUS Burn — 30s launch VO (female read)

I can't generate audio. This is a script to hand a reader or a TTS voice.

**Casting:** woman, 28–40, warm but low-energy. Think a friend telling you
something slightly conspiratorial across a table, not an announcer. Dry, a
little amused. Never bright, never upsell.

**Direction:** conversational pace, land hard on the short sentences, let the
silences sit. Close mic, minimal room. No smile in the voice on the last line.

## Timed to the eight beats

| Beat | In–Out | Line |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Type | 0:00–0:03 | *(silence — only the typing)* |
| 2 Reveal | 0:03–0:06 | "Some things you only want to say once." |
| 3 Encrypt | 0:06–0:10 | "Burn encrypts it in your browser." |
| 4 Ready | 0:10–0:15 | "You get a link and a two-digit code. Tell them the code." |
| 5 Open | 0:15–0:21 | "They open it. They read it." |
| 6 Gone | 0:21–0:24 | "That's the only time it opens." |
| 7 File | 0:24–0:27 | "Notes or one file. No account." |
| 8 End | 0:27–0:30 | "NO SUS Burn. Try it at nosus.foo." |

## Read as one take

> *(three seconds of typing)*
>
> Some things you only want to say once.
>
> Burn encrypts it in your browser.
>
> You get a link and a two-digit code. Tell them the code.
>
> They open it. They read it.
>
> *(beat)* That's the only time it opens.
>
> Notes or one file. No account.
>
> NO SUS Burn. Try it at nosus.foo.

About 62 words, roughly 21 seconds spoken across 30. The gaps are scored.

## For the 15-second cut

Keep beats 3, 4, 7 and 8 only:

> Burn encrypts it in your browser. You get a link and a two-digit code.
> Notes or one file, no account. NO SUS Burn — try it at nosus.foo.

## Sound design

Same rule as the picture: flat, dry, no tails. Everything is close and small —
no whooshes, no risers, no cinematic booms, no fire. The bed is near-silence so
the hits land.

**Bed (0:00–0:30):** a very low room tone, almost inaudible. Under the working
beats (3 and 7) add a faint electrical hum, maybe 1–2 dB above the floor. Cut
it dead at 0:27 so the end card is pure silence behind the last line.

| Beat | Time | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Type | 0:00–0:02.4 | Real mechanical keystrokes, one per character, slightly uneven. Dry, no reverb. A short pause before "delete this." |
| 2 Reveal | 0:03 | One soft low thud on the cut as the camera pulls back. |
| | 0:05.4 | A single firm click on the BURN NOTE press — the only "button" sound in the piece. |
| 3 Encrypt | 0:06–0:10 | A quiet cyclic tick under the spinning ring, about 4 per second, low in the mix. |
| 4 Ready | 0:10.2 | One clean latch-close, like a small lock seating. |
| | 0:11 | A soft tick as "77" snaps in. |
| | 0:11.2–0:11.7 | Very light granular texture while the QR draws, then nothing. |
| | 0:13.2 | A short dry snap on COPY LINK flipping to COPIED. |
| 5 Open | 0:15.2–0:16.2 | A faint air movement as the link travels. Keep it under the voice. |
| | 0:16.5 | One soft tap as it lands on the phone. |
| | 0:18.8–0:20.3 | Reverse the keystroke sound for the erase, quieter and speeding up as it clears. |
| 6 Gone | 0:21.9 | One tap. Then nothing — a full two seconds of dead air. This is the loudest moment in the piece. |
| 7 File | 0:24 | Hard cut: a sharp low transient, no tail. |
| | 0:24.6 | A dull paper-ish drop as the file lands in the zone. |
| | 0:25.5–0:26.8 | The cyclic tick returns, then one latch-close on SEALING. |
| 8 End | 0:27 | Silence. Optionally one very quiet low note under the wordmark, decaying by 0:29. |

**Mix:** voice at the front, effects roughly 12–15 dB under it, bed another
10 under that. Nothing should compete with the 0:21 silence.

## If you record it

Turn Supers off in Tweaks so the reader and the on-screen line don't double
up, or keep only the beat-8 end-card line.
